name: Weighted Blending (Fuzzy Metaballs)
definition: A sort-free rendering technique for 3D Gaussians that computes intersections between a ray and each Gaussian separately, then combines them using a weighted average of intersection depths, avoiding the need to sort Gaussians by depth.
summary: Weighted Blending is a sort-free ray-marching technique that blends 3D Gaussian intersections via weighted depth averages, avoiding the computational cost of sorting.
